KPI.testo: A measure chosen to tell whether a goal or a process is going as it should, compared with an expected value.

OKR.testo: A qualitative objective with a few measurable results that say when it is reached.

ESCO.esteso: European classification of skills, competences and occupations
ESCO.testo: The European Commission vocabulary that gives a common name to jobs and skills.

ISCO.testo: The occupation classification of the International Labour Organization (ISCO-08).

RACI.testo: Who carries out an activity, who answers for it, who must be heard before and who must be told after.

VRIO.testo: A way to judge whether a capability is a lasting competitive advantage: it must be valuable, rare, hard to copy and supported by the organization.

CCNL.testo: The sector agreement that sets levels, minimum pay, hours, holidays and leave. For a bank it is the credit-sector CCNL.

RAL.testo: What the person earns in a year before tax and contributions, without variable bonuses.

ROL.testo: Hours of paid leave that the collective agreement grants every year, on top of holidays.

FTE.testo: People counted in proportion to their hours: two half-time people are 1 FTE.

HR.testo: The function that manages people, organization, pay and development.

GDPR.testo: The European regulation 2016/679 on the processing of personal data.

DPO.testo: The role that oversees that personal data is processed according to the GDPR; sees sensitive data in masked form.

MFA.testo: Access asks, besides the password, for a second element: a code from the phone or an app.

TOTP.testo: The six-digit code that an authenticator app generates and that changes every 30 seconds.

RBAC.testo: What a person can do depends on the roles assigned to them.

OU.testo: A node of the org chart: department, area, office, branch.

NACE.testo: The code of the sector a company operates in; in Italy its version is ATECO.

ATECO.testo: The Italian version of NACE, used by ISTAT and the Chambers of Commerce.

ERP.testo: The management system that holds accounting, purchasing and payroll (for example SAP or Zucchetti).

IA.testo: The agents that read the data, propose and, where allowed, execute.

AI.testo: The agents that read the data, propose and, where allowed, execute.

IBAN.testo: The code of the account into which the salary is paid.

PIP.testo: Everything that describes a position: duties, expected skills, relationships, pay data.

SLA.testo: The time within which a request must be taken on or closed.

coorte.testo: The group of people who follow the same edition of a training initiative, with the same dates.

posti.testo: How many people the edition can take; free seats are the difference from the enrolled.

dimensione.testo: The size band of the client company, measured on the number of people.

priorita.testo: How soon the request must be decided: high means that the delay blocks someone.

grado.testo: The step of the level in the taxonomy scale: higher means more mastery.

famiglia.testo: The grouping of related categories of the skills taxonomy.

unitaSuperiore.testo: The organizational unit that contains this one, a step above in the tree.

processoEAttivita.testo: The work process the request belongs to and the step where it is waiting.

affinita.testo: How much the person's profile resembles the required one, from 0 to 100: higher means less distance to cover.

affinitaRuolo.testo: How much the person's skills cover those of the job role, from 0 to 100.

capacita.testo: What the organization can do thanks to the people and skills it has, measured on the positions that carry it.

carico.testo: How many requests or people weigh on someone compared with what they can bear.

fiducia.testo: How solid the estimate is: low means few or old data, so to be taken with caution.

rarita.testo: How hard it is to find the resource outside: a rare capability is an advantage that competitors do not have.

inimitabilita.testo: How hard it would be for a competitor to copy the resource (VRIO analysis).

evidenza.testo: The fact that supports the judgement: a finished course, a review, a certificate.

giudizio.testo: The assessment given on this point, with its reason.

verdetto.testo: The outcome of the check: confirmed, to be reviewed or rejected.

umore.testo: How the person said they feel in the survey, on a scale from very bad to very good.

soddisfazione.testo: How satisfied people say they are, on average over the answers collected.

riportiDiretti.testo: The people who report directly to this position, one step below.

riportiTransitivi.testo: All the people under this position in the chain, at any depth.

posizioniTotali.testo: The active positions of the unit, filled and vacant.

prototipo.testo: The reference organizational model of the sector that the company starts from and adapts.

regolaDiApprovazione.testo: Who must approve, in what order and with which thresholds, for this kind of request.

rilevazioni.testo: The times the measure was collected in the period.

iscrizione.testo: The person is enrolled in the initiative: the status tells whether they started it, finished it or left it.

obbligatorio.testo: The course must be taken by law or by internal rule; missing it is a breach.

occupazione.testo: The profession in the European ESCO classification that the role corresponds to.

criticita.testo: How much the position weighs for the organization if it stayed vacant: high means that without a holder an important process stops.

copertura.testo: Share of positions with an active holder out of all the active positions.

scoperta.testo: An active position without an assigned holder.

scoperte.testo: Active positions without an assigned holder.

titolare.testo: The person who currently occupies the position. It is distinct from the owner, who answers for the position.

proprietario.testo: Who answers for the position (usually the head of the unit): defines it and decides who occupies it.

riportaA.testo: The position above in the hierarchical chain.

successione.testo: The people ready, or being prepared, to take a position when the holder leaves it.

prontezza.testo: How long before a succession candidate could really take the position: now, within a year, within three.

potenziale.testo: How much the person is expected to be able to grow, distinct from how they work today (performance).

prestazione.testo: How the person worked in the period, according to the review.

nineBox.testo: The three-by-three grid that crosses performance and potential and suggests what to do with each person.

9Box.testo: The three-by-three grid that crosses performance and potential and suggests what to do with each person.

gap.testo: The distance between the skill level the position asks for and the one the person has.

divario.testo: The distance between the skill level the position asks for and the one the person has.

livello.testo: The classification level of the collective agreement, which sets the minimum pay.

bandaRetributiva.testo: The pay range foreseen for a level or a family of positions: minimum, midpoint, maximum.

compaRatio.testo: The person's pay divided by the midpoint of their band: 100% is the centre, below 80% or above 120% deserves a look.

turnover.testo: The exits of the period in relation to the average headcount.

assenteismo.testo: The hours of unplanned absence in relation to the workable hours.

maturazione.testo: The days or hours of holiday and leave that the person earns as the months go by.

saldo.testo: What is left to take: accrued, plus carry-over, minus taken.

riporto.testo: Holidays or leave not taken the year before and carried into the current one.

perimetro.testo: The set of units and people that your role lets you see.

mandato.testo: The role that gives access: it says what you can do (read, edit) and on which scope.

tenant.testo: A client company of the platform, with its data kept separate from the others.

provenienza.testo: Where the data comes from: created here (native), imported from another system, or imported and then enriched (hybrid).

origine.testo: Where the data comes from: created here (native), imported from another system, or imported and then enriched (hybrid).

organico.testo: The people with an active employment relationship.

anzianita.testo: How long the person has worked at the company.

unitaOrganizzativa.testo: A node of the org chart: department, area, office, branch.

ferie.testo: The days of paid rest that accrue every month under the collective agreement.

permessi.testo: Hours of paid absence (ROL, former holidays, statutory leave) on top of holidays.

straordinario.testo: The hours worked beyond the contractual hours, paid with a premium or recovered.

straordinari.testo: The hours worked beyond the contractual hours, paid with a premium or recovered.

obiettivo.testo: A result agreed for the period, with a weight and a way to measure it.

obiettivi.testo: The results agreed for the period, each with a weight and a way to measure it.

peso.testo: How much this item counts on the total: a person's weights add up to 100%.

risultatoChiave.testo: A number that says whether the goal is reached (the "key result" of an OKR).

valutazione.testo: The period judgement on performance, given by the manager and, where foreseen, calibrated.

ciclo.testo: The review period (usually a year) with its deadlines: goals, mid-year check, final review.

competenza.testo: A professional ability described in a catalogue (ESCO or company), with a level from 1 to 5.

competenze.testo: The professional abilities described in a catalogue (ESCO or company), each with a level from 1 to 5.

livelloAtteso.testo: The skill level that the position asks of whoever occupies it.

certificazione.testo: A certificate issued by a body, with an expiry date after which it must be renewed.

certificazioni.testo: Certificates issued by a body, each with an expiry date after which it must be renewed.

scadenza.testo: The date after which the item is no longer valid and must be renewed or closed.

percorsoFormativo.testo: A sequence of courses designed to close a skill gap or prepare for a role.

approvatore.testo: Who must decide on the request: the manager, or whoever received the delegation.

delega.testo: The power to approve passed temporarily to another person (for example during an absence).

punteggio.testo: The numeric value of the review, on the scale shown next to it.

rischioDiUscita.testo: The estimated probability that the person leaves the company in the coming months, from signals such as seniority, reviews and the market.

indice.testo: A number made of several measures, on a scale from 0 to 100: higher is better, unless stated otherwise.

fascia.testo: The pay range foreseen for the level: minimum, midpoint, maximum.

variabile.testo: The part of pay tied to results, paid if the agreed thresholds are exceeded.

premio.testo: A one-off amount tied to a result or an event.

lordo.testo: The amount before tax and contributions.

netto.testo: The amount that reaches the account, after tax and contributions.

inquadramento.testo: Level and grade of the collective agreement that define minimums and duties.

mansione.testo: The work the person does, as described in the contract.

sede.testo: The person's usual place of work.

ruoloProfessionale.testo: The job described in the catalogue (family and role), independent of the single position.

maturato.testo: What has been earned so far in the year: days or hours that grow every month.

goduto.testo: What has already been used: days or hours of absence taken.

residuo.testo: What is left to use: accrued plus carry-over, minus taken.

flightRisk.testo: The estimated probability that the person leaves the company in the coming months, from signals such as seniority, reviews and the market.

scope.testo: The set of units and people a rule or a permission applies to.

policy.testo: The written rule that says what is allowed or required, and for whom.

workflow.testo: The sequence of steps of a case, with who carries them out and in what order.

feedback.testo: The response a person gives or receives on a piece of work, an interview or a period.

processo.testo: An ordered set of activities that produces a result for the organization. The tenant processes are the first-level processes; each one can contain subprocesses.

sottoprocesso.testo: A part of a process, with its own name, that groups some of its activities. It is not counted among the processes: it sits inside the process it belongs to.

attivitaDiProcesso.testo: A step of a process, in the order it happens, with who performs it (unit, position, role or agent), what it receives and what it produces.

processoDelModello.testo: The reusable definition of a process, valid for a sector and independent of any single company. It is adapted to a tenant through configuration.

partecipazioneUnita.testo: How a unit takes part in the process: R performs, A is accountable for the result, C is consulted, I is informed.

processoDelTenant.testo: The model process as this company lives it: with its owner, subprocesses, activities and the units that take part.

sensiDelProcesso.introduzione: Heuresys keeps apart five different things that everyday language calls «process». Every page that counts processes says which of the five it counts, so two different numbers do not look like an error.
sensiDelProcesso.definizione: A business process is a coordinated set of activities, decisions and interactions, triggered by events or conditions, that uses resources and information to produce verifiable results for identified beneficiaries, within defined responsibilities, constraints and performance criteria.

tassonomia.domanda: Where the process sits and how it is classified
tassonomia.nonE: A description of the work flow
tassonomia.dove: Coming: domain, family and characteristics of every process

metamodello.domanda: Which elements describe a process and how they are linked

blueprint.domanda: What is the reusable definition of a process, valid for a sector
blueprint.nonE: How a single company lives it

configurazione.domanda: How the model process is adapted to this company: owner, subprocesses, activities, units

istanza.domanda: What happened in a single run of the process
istanza.dove: Approval requests and projects linked to a process

livelli.titolo: The five levels: where the process sits
livelli.nota: Levels say how work breaks down, not in which order it happens. «Process» or «subprocess» inside a tenant only says how deeply a process is nested in another: a subprocess is still a third-level process.

l3.definizione: Transformation with defined boundaries, result and responsibility

l4.definizione: Meaningful unit of work of the process

l5.definizione: Action described at the operational level needed

catena.testo: The model process names process roles; the tenant process binds them to positions; the person comes from who holds the position at the date. No process names a person directly.
